entities.name: Krenko
entities.description: A young, ambitious goblin crime boss in Ravnica who takes jobs from the patron Mr. Taz and sows chaos in Sunhome to steal a feather from an imprisoned angel.

entities.name: Mr. Taz
entities.description: A mysterious patron in an ill-fitting skin-suit who hires Krenko for heists and pays him with a key to an Orzhov safebox.

entities.name: Feather
entities.description: A white-winged angel and the Boros guildmaster who is held in magical stasis in a detention sphere and who earlier earned a salary as a Wojek.

entities.name: Aurelia
entities.description: A Boros leader who claims no disgraced angel has the right to rule and is set to become the guild's new master.

entities.name: Azzik
entities.description: A loyal goblin who works for Krenko and can barely count past ten.

entities.name: Pondl
entities.description: A loyal goblin who works for Krenko and can barely count past ten.

entities.name: Boros Legion
entities.description: The guild of Ravnica that loves straight lines and hard work, whose Sunhome guildhall Krenko infiltrates.

entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: A guild of unpredictable thugs that Krenko despises.

entities.name: Azorius
entities.description: The guild that found a fine-print loophole forcing the Boros duel.

entities.name: Golgari
entities.description: The guild whose corpse-hauler carries away dead Boros soldiers.

entities.name: Orzhov
entities.description: The guild whose symbol marks the silver key Taz gives Krenko.

entities.name: Gruul
entities.description: The guild of the Rubblebelt, which a Boros goblin assumes Krenko belongs to.

entities.name: Sunhome
entities.description: The imposing Boros guildhall, with a vast mess hall and Vinrenn's chambers on the top floor.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The city-plane where the guilds operate.

entities.name: The Millennial
entities.description: An aerial platform with the most coveted views in Ravnica where Krenko meets Taz.

entities.name: Orzhova
entities.description: The Orzhov guildhall where Krenko can retrieve the money.

entities.name: Orzhov safebox key
entities.description: A silver key with the Orzhov symbol that retrieves Feather's money.

entities.name: Taz's glowing shiv
entities.description: An enchanted glowing dagger Taz gives Krenko, used to smash the detention sphere.

entities.name: Detention sphere
entities.description: A glassy magical sphere that holds Feather in stasis.

events.summary: Mr. Taz meets Krenko in a smoky pub and hires him for a Boros heist, giving him a glowing shiv.
events.quote: Here is a special tool to help you in your endeavor."

events.summary: Krenko surveys Sunhome from a rooftop and notes many dead soldiers loaded onto a Golgari corpse-hauler.
events.quote: Krenko began his surveillance on Sunhome, the imposing Boros guildhall.

events.summary: In the mess hall Krenko overhears Boros soldiers saying the guild's succession has come down to a duel, found by the Azorius in the fine print.
events.quote: "No, the nosy Azorius found it in the fine print," he said.

events.summary: A fistfight breaks out among the soldiers, and Krenko enjoys the tension.
events.quote: Such undisciplined hot-headedness seemed very un-Boros.

events.summary: A goblin worker tells Krenko that Aurelia will replace the disgraced angel Vinrenn as master, who will be banished.
events.quote: Aurelia's gonna be our new master, 'cause she says that no disgraced angel's got the right to rule.

events.summary: Krenko sets fires and bombs through the floors of Sunhome to create chaos and slips unnoticed into Vinrenn's chambers.
events.quote: Chaos is the best cover, and Krenko went about setting fires and kicking down doors.

events.summary: Krenko finds an angel in stasis inside a detention sphere and smashes it open with the shiv's handle.
events.quote: With another good smash, the sphere dissipated, sending the angel tumbling unceremoniously to the floor.

events.summary: Krenko plucks two feathers from the angel and falsely screams that she attacked him, and guards seize her.
events.quote: "She tried to escape! She's free. She attacked me!"

events.summary: As Krenko leaves, a large explosion rocks Sunhome.
Krenko delivers the angel's feather to Taz on the Millennial and receives an Orzhov safebox key holding Feather's money.
events.quote: Taz handed him a silver key with the Orzhov symbol carved into the shaft.

events.summary: Taz hints at a further job in the Orzhova after calling Krenko the boss of something grand.
events.quote: I can see you as the boss of something grand.

relations.note: He takes paying jobs from Taz as his patron.
relations.quote: Yes, Krenko liked this slippery-face man who kept offering him delicious jobs.

relations.note: A loyal goblin of Krenko's crew.
relations.quote: Azzik and Pondl were loyal but could barely count past ten.

relations.note: A loyal goblin of Krenko's crew.
relations.quote: Azzik and Pondl were loyal but could barely count past ten.
This was good because Krenko despised the Rakdos thugs.

relations.note: She seeks to replace and banish the disgraced angel.
She is the guildmaster, though disputed.
relations.quote: the guildmaster who apparently lacked control.
